The Figma has the urgent content frame 805:492 (72) but no Hoje frame with the urgent-care banner (#73), and page 02 has no urgent variant of the Aviso: the urgent treatment (outlined card, URGENTE label in estado/negativo) comes from 805:492 only.

captureScope: sim.sh captures only the viewport shown after launch (one 1206 x 2622 screenshot, the top of the screen). The Figma frames are full scroll height (figma.png), so content below the fold (Prova card, rows, tab-bar overlap) is not in the capture; compare the visible part.
